column2: The Standard of the Albanian Crown
The Albanian protectorate now serves beneath the Bourbon crown. Its standard joins the Albanian eagle to the arms of the protecting dynasty, recording the arrangement already concluded with Italy.
The relationship that established the Bourbon standard has changed. The protectorate resumes its ordinary designation and colours.
The Standard of the Guianese Protectorate
The existing Guianese protectorate now flies the colours of its Bourbon patron. Italian colours, royal arms and the Atlantic waters mark the authority already exercised over the colony.
The relationship that established the Bourbon standard has changed. The colony resumes its ordinary colonial designation and colours.
